questions.question: Which of the following is a common English word for 'couleurs'?
'The English word for 'nombres' is 'numbers'' is a true statement.
Which of the following is a common English word for 'formes'?
'The English word for 'couleurs' is 'colors'' is a true statement.
Which of the following is a common English word for 'nombres'?
'The English word for 'formes' is 'shapes'' is a true statement.
Which of the following is a common English word for 'couleurs'?
'The English word for 'nombres' is 'digits'' is a true statement.
